data.name: Speaker for the Past
data.description: A speaker for the past is a shaman who specifically serves as the voice for spirits from her people's history. A speaker for the past is often an advocate of the ancestors of a specific group, the voice of experience, and a powerful resource that allows the past to aid the present.
